_meta.notes: ⚠ THE SPLIT-FILING BRIEF IS WRONG ABOUT THIS PAIR, AND THE DOCUMENTS SAY SO. This 4-page PDF is a COMPLETE report on its own: cover (p1) + Summary Page (p2) + Schedule A (p3, blank) + Schedule B (p4, 7 rows). Its partner `...burdick-fin-report-3.pdf` is NOT the missing other half of a split Schedule B - it is a second scan of THIS filing's OWN Schedule B page: same 7 rows, same dates, same amounts, same printed subtotal 9,533.28 and grand total 9,533.28, same stray diagonal pencil line, same header ('Burdick', '9-15-20'). The two scans are not byte-identical (embedded images 1654x2170 vs 1654x2171, 582K vs 591K) and their rule geometry differs by ~0.15% of page height, so they are two passes over one sheet, not one file copied. Consequence for the wave: the partner adds NO new expenditure rows, and the pair must not be summed - doing so would double-count $9,533.28. LISTING vs FORM: the clerk listing calls this 'Amendment to Sept 2020'; the FORM does not mark itself an amendment - the 'September 15' interim box is ticked and NEITHER amendment box (Yes/No) is ticked, so is_amendment is honestly blank and amendment_of is empty. Cover reads Office 'SLCO Council', Office Sought 'Council', District 'D-6', Party 'Rep.' - all verbatim; the candidate's street address, phone and email blocks are covered by the county bar. Summary Column A line 1 and line 4 both carry a slashed-zero glyph = 0 (zero-glyph ruling); Column B is populated (30,371.62 / 23,187.86), so the zero is a genuine no-contributions period, not an empty cell. Both Summary Page and Schedule A print 'Page 1 of 1'.
